Name: Angry Seagulls
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Angry Seagulls[/b] is a mod that adds one to three angry seagulls to the beach each day that try to steal food from you.

They have 3 hitpoints and deal 1 damage.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Remove seagulls at end of day, fix error when you don't have any food, fix all bats stealing food.
